banner.tagline: Hermes, but it texts you first.
banner.blurb: Keeps your goals, promises and decisions, then speaks on its own schedule. Small calls are settled for you after two unanswered asks. Money, public and irreversible ones never are.
banner.card:
Move tomorrow's gym from 6am to 7am?  yes / no
I'd go with yes. If I don't hear back, I'll do that in 2h.
Reply yes or no.
